fixed_budget_definition: total accepted body-fetch attempts <= 2, failures and cancellations consume attempts

freeze_record.scope: new independent development diagnostic, not R3 or formal paper evidence
freeze_record.selection: fixed first12 development tasks per benchmark, no outcome selection
freeze_record.network: BG1KiB/2s at64kbit; two tasks arrive each1s; common all groups
freeze_record.algorithm: paper rolling kNN and hard constraints unchanged; improved uses broader warmup coverage

provider_failure_policy.model_concurrency_scope: Local HTTP operations through actual transport cleanup; remote provider backend jobs are not observable or bounded by this client.
provider_failure_policy.ordinary_provider_failure: HTTP 502/504, transport EOF and timeout fail the affected call/task only; all arrived tasks remain in the denominator and missing/invalid answers score zero. Unrelated tasks continue after confirmed local HTTP termination.
provider_failure_policy.retry_and_accounting: No automatic retry or budget refund. Preserve consumed attempts, failed call records, unknown remote terminal state and unknown usage; unknown usage is NA with known-cost lower bounds, never zero.
provider_failure_policy.stop_rule: Ordinary provider transport failures do not close unrelated provider calls or pause a completed block. Model identity/integrity failures, authentication gates and global budget/measurement/protocol violations retain their declared stop or invalidation behavior.
provider_failure_policy.resume_rule: Use the same frozen checkpoint rules for independent process interruptions; completed blocks and failed task outcomes are preserved, never selectively rerun.
provider_failure_policy.invalid_block: Model identity mismatch, exhausted experiment call budget, invalid measurement, or controller/protocol violation remain invalid; authentication failures retain the fail-closed gate.
provider_failure_policy.prior_run: R1 and all 23 R2 primary completed cells are diagnostic only. R3 starts every primary cell afresh, with no R1/R2 score imports.
